title: International business card · Specifications for front
slide_intent: Adjust type size to the information load on a small card. A recipient needs to distinguish the cardholder’s name and find a contact channel quickly.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can make the international card recognizable at standard size while improving readability when fewer details are needed.
demonstration: An annotated 54 × 85 mm card fixes name and job title in position while contact lines build from below. Two smaller specimens compare standard and larger text.
practical_value: Use the 7 pt contact setting for the fuller card or the 8.5 pt option when space permits. Keep the 13.5 mm mark and its 3.5 mm top and right offsets consistent.

content_islands.name: Format and typesetting
content_islands.spec: List the format, ink, stock, margins and six numbered settings at left.

content_islands.name: Maximum-content specimen
content_islands.spec: Show the front at upper right on a pale panel. Mark the fixed name lines and the lower contact rows with separate colored guides.

content_islands.spec: Pair a standard-size example with the larger-type option below. Keep the international mark visible on both.
